name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, December 09, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy from Lomita Station
b.
South Bay Workforce Investment Board (SBWIB) Quarterly Update
c.
State of the City Address - Mayor Sanchez
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Adjourned Regular Meeting held on November 10, 2015 and the Special Meeting held on November 24, 2015.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7b
c.
Resolution 2015-56 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks and Recreation Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7h
i.
October 2015 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7i
j.
Consideration of a Professional Services Agreement with HR Green California, Inc. to provide Engineering Services Related to Subdivision Review.
ACTION: Authorize the Interim City Manager to execute an Agreement for a term of two years, with two-year options for renewal with HR Green California INC, to provide professional engineering services as it relates to subdivision review.
Item 7j
k.
Ord. No. 776 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving Code Amendment 2015-05 an amendment to Section 2-1.01 of the Lomita Municipal Code to change the regular Council meeting days to be effective the first meeting in February. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said Ordinance No. 776 be adopted.
Item 7k
l.
Consideration of a Resolution supporting four petitions related to Helicopter Noise Relief submitted to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) by the Los Angeles Area Helicopter Noise Coalition on October 20, 2015
Res 2015-57 - A Resolution in support of four petitions related to Helicopter Noise Relief submitted to the FAA by the Los Angeles Area Helicopter Noise Coalition on October 20, 2015.
ACTION: Adopt a resolution supporting four petitions related to helicopter noise relief submitted to the FAA by the Los Angeles Area Helicopter Noise Coalition on October 20, 2015.
Item 7l
m.
Consideration of canceling the December 23, 2015 Council meeting.
ACTION: Cancel the regular City Council meeting of December 23, 2015 and direct staff to take the necessary steps to initiate the meeting cancellation.
Item 7m
n.
Award of an agreement to West Coast Arborists, Inc. for Tree Maintenance Services.
ACTION: Award an agreement for tree maintenance services to West Coast Arborists, Inc. for an amount not to exceed $41,000 per year, for a term of three (3) years and authorize the Interim City Manager to execute the agreement.
Item 7n
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION SETTING A DATE FOR A STREET IMPROVEMENT WORKSHOP
Presented by Interim City Manager Burrell
ACTION: Select one of the following dates for the Street Improvement Workshop:
Regular City Council meeting:
January 13, 2016
January 27, 2016
February 2, 2016
Item 8
9.
OATH OF OFFICE AND ISSUANCE OF CERTIFICATE OF APPOINTMENT
10.
SELECTION OF MAYOR AND MAYOR PRO TEM FOR 2015-16
11.
PRESENTATION OF PLAQUE TO OUTGOING MAYOR SANCHEZ
12.
APPOINTMENT OF COUNCIL MEMBERS TO VARIOUS ORGANIZATIONS
Item 12
13.
ADJOURNMENT The regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on January 13, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
